authority: Explicit current-session instructions; document drafting followed by a fresh council and bounded document iteration.
instructions: Once the package impact assessment document is constructed invoke the council. Expect at least a 9.5 score in order to move on. A loop up to 4 times without getting me involved
Make sure that I have a link to the impact assessment when it is completed. I would like to review it in tandem with the council.
early_stop: Every seat VERIFIED, no mandatory finding, independent coverage and overall scores each at least 9.5/10.
scoring: Score honestly; never inflate to satisfy the gate. Do not average seats or waive a mandatory finding with a score.
authorized_corrections: Bounded non-destructive documentation corrections to this assessment, its traceability, approval-condition records and current routing. Record finding dispositions and freeze a new candidate before a new full assessment review.
technical_boundary: Summarize current reviewed REM, compatibility annex and Tools companion. Do not silently amend those frozen contracts, authorize another package or implement their proposed changes. Report a material uncovered design issue for explicit scope disposition.
do_not_repeat: No new implementation review, model/dependency qualification, store operations or full feature-design rewrite is authorized by this document review.
maintainer_review: Provide a direct assessment link now and on revision; maintainer may review in parallel. Council verification does not satisfy the maintainer's package-impact approval condition.
stop_after_four: Stop and present remaining findings/scores for guidance if the qualifying gate has not been achieved. No automatic extra or replacement council round.
authority_not_granted: product code/tests/package metadata edits or runtime configuration changes
provider/model calls, user-store inspection/reset/migration or cleanup
construction directive approval or maintainer satisfaction/acceptance
push, PR, merge, publication or delivery

lightweight_change_exemption.scope: Assessment, criteria, authorization, current status/navigation, append-only evidence/log and bounded document corrections only.
lightweight_change_exemption.reason: Explicit document drafting and review request; no product behavior, metadata, lock or runtime configuration changes.
lightweight_change_exemption.validation: Independent read-only document council plus board/dashboard, documentation lifecycle, metadata, scoped whitespace and preservation checks.
